ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Pi-hole admin dashboard. Auto-generated during install.

TZ.description: Timezone for log display and rotation (e.g. America/New_York).

FTLCONF_webserver_api_password.description: Password for the Pi-hole admin dashboard. Auto-generated during install.

FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode.description: DNS listening mode. Must be 'all' for container networking.

FTLCONF_files_database.description: Path to the FTL long-term database. Relocated to /data/pihole for virtiofs compatibility.

FTLCONF_files_gravity.description: Path to the gravity (blocklist) database. Relocated to /data/pihole for virtiofs compatibility.

FTLCONF_files_macvendor.description: Path to the MAC vendor lookup database. Relocated to /data/pihole for virtiofs compatibility.

PIHOLE_UID.description: Override UID for the pihole user. Set to 0 to run as root for virtiofs compatibility.

PIHOLE_GID.description: Override GID for the pihole group. Set to 0 to run as root for virtiofs compatibility.

DNSMASQ_USER.description: User running the FTL DNS engine. Set to root for virtiofs compatibility.
